{{Top|leg}}
'''O'bekis''' were areas of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]] where the [[Gorothite/Legends|Gorothites]] lived and rebuilt their civilization in the years following [[Se'Lenti|the Scouring]]. Each o'beki was ruled by a [[P'Dar'Ib]].
